newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July gold output rises 23.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July gold output rises 23.2 percent.

text.p: Peru's gold output rose 23.2 percent to 5.90 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production rose 17.4 percent to 37.94 tonnes in the first seven months of the year compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.

Peru is Latin America's second largest gold producer after Brazil and the 12th largest in the world. The country's largest gold producer is Minera Yanacocha S.A., a joint venture operated by U.S.-based Newmont Mining Co..
The ministry's figures include 1994 estimates for output by Peru's informal gold miners who account for about 40 percent of national output.
